notes: Official images currently provide linux/amd64; Docker Desktop on Apple Silicon uses emulation.
DB_MIN_CNX and DB_MAX_CNX are the documented settings; upstream sample BD_MIN_CNX spelling is not used.
api command serves internal HTTP; ssl-api would force HTTPS picture links and is intentionally not used.
No image/photograph dataset is installed or fetched by starting this private companion.
Dedicated Linux-managed PostgreSQL storage avoids first-start owner mapping failures reproduced on Docker Desktop external macOS bind mounts. Back up with pg_dump and the separate picture folder.
